name: cloud-store
description: Diego's Cloud Store — the constellation app store as its own APK (#865). Hosts libs:appstore: the Cloud fleet list (install, update, download-all, auto-update on Wi-Fi), the phone's installed apps (stop, uninstall, sources) and the apps mesh. It also runs the background fleet pass that keeps every constellation app updated, Cloud SuperApp and itself included. Split out of cloud-superapp so the store ships and updates on its own.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps. KEY LOCATION: A_A0-Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A_A0-Providers/D_TOOLS-DEVICES/d2-android/signing.secrets.yaml.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph. settings.gradle iterates this list. Every lib is shared BY REFERENCE from ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs, the same directories cloud-superapp builds, so the store code exists once.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.

tests._doc: Read by 1_cicd/dist/scripts/cloud-android-test-engine.sh, which the ship workflow runs before it builds.

web._doc: #876 the store as a Kotlin/Wasm page (web/ is its own gradle root; the shared libs' pure-Compose sources arrive through the ab_cloud-libs-shared/web composite). Rendered into 1_cicd/src/cicd/ship-cloud-store-wasm.yml by the workflow generator: `./gradlew wasmJsBrowserDistribution` in `dir`, tested by test/test-store-web.sh, `build/dist/wasmJs/productionExecutable` zipped to `artifact` and attached to the rolling release as `gh_asset`, then diegonmarcos.github.io is told (repository_dispatch cloud-web-refresh). portal_slug is the tile's apps/<slug>/ folder on the cloud-web portal; entry is the page inside it. The APK's own ship ignores this directory.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl): ui.bottom_nav is the island, ui.sections[] what each item opens, ui.default_section where the app opens. The four Store pages are sections without sub-pages; MainActivity hosts each page's own screen.
